findings.summary: The Start→Process edge has no connecting line or arrowhead at all, unlike the Process→End edge in the same diagram.
findings.evidence: asciiText shows '└────┬────┘' under the Start box followed by five blank lines (no '│' or '▼') before the Process box begins; the Process→End edge right below it draws '│' four times plus a '▼'. The SVG confirms edge L_A_B_0 (Start→Process) has a marker-end arrowhead, same as L_B_C_0 which renders correctly.

findings.summary: The Start→'Is it sunny?' edge has no visible connecting line or arrowhead.
findings.evidence: asciiText shows '╰───────┬──────╯' under the Start box followed by five blank lines with no '│', before the diamond '◇──────────────◇' begins. The SVG's edge L_A_B_0 (A→B) has a marker-end arrowhead confirming the edge should be drawn.

findings.summary: The React App→State Manager edge inside the Frontend subgraph has no connecting line or arrowhead.
findings.evidence: asciiText shows '└───────┬───────┘' under the React App box followed by five blank lines with no '│', before the State Manager box begins. The SVG's edge L_A_B_0 (React App→State Manager) has a marker-end arrowhead.

findings.summary: The main→develop edge has no connecting line or arrowhead between the two boxes.
findings.evidence: The ASCII row '│ main ├     │ develop ├─────►│ feature/auth ├...' shows only blank spaces between 'main' and 'develop', while the adjacent develop→feature/auth edge in the same row is drawn with dashes and a '►' arrowhead. The SVG's edge L_A_B_0 (main→develop) has a marker-end arrowhead confirming it should render.

findings.summary: The initial-state ([*])→Idle transition has no connecting line or arrowhead.
findings.evidence: asciiText shows the start marker box '●────────────────●' followed by five blank lines with no '│', before the Idle box begins, while every other transition (Idle↔Active, Active→Done, Done→[*]) is drawn with explicit '│'/'▲'/'▼' connectors. The SVG's edge0 ([*]→Idle) has a marker-end arrowhead.

findings.summary: The initial-state ([*])→Closed transition has no connecting line or arrowhead.
findings.evidence: asciiText shows the start marker box '●──────────────────●' followed by five blank lines with no '│', before the Closed box begins, while all nine other transitions in this diagram (connect, success, timeout, close, error, max_retries, done, etc.) are drawn with explicit connectors and arrowheads. The SVG's edge0 ([*]→Closed) has a marker-end arrowhead.

findings.summary: The first message (Alice→Bob, 'Hello Bob!') is drawn with a dashed/solid line but no arrowhead, so its direction is lost.
findings.evidence: asciiText shows '│─────────────── ' for 'Hello Bob!' ending in blank space with no arrow glyph, while the reply 'Hi Alice!' correctly shows '◀╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌' with an arrowhead. The SVG's messageLine0 (data-from="Alice" data-to="Bob") has marker-end="url(#...-arrowhead)", confirming an arrowhead should render at Bob's end.

findings.summary: The first message (Client→Server, 'Login') is drawn with a line but no arrowhead, so its direction is lost.
findings.evidence: asciiText shows '│───────────────────── ' for 'Login' ending in blank space with no arrow glyph, while all three reply messages (200 OK, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden) correctly show a leading '◀' arrowhead. The SVG's messageLine0 (data-from="C" data-to="S") has marker-end="url(#...-arrowhead)", confirming an arrowhead should render at Server's end.

findings.summary: The first message (User→Client App, 'Click Login') is drawn with a line but no arrowhead, so its direction is lost.
findings.evidence: asciiText shows '│─────────────────                             │                 │' for 'Click Login' with no arrow glyph, while every other one of the diagram's nine messages (Authorization request, Login page, Credentials, etc.) correctly shows a '▶' or '◀' arrowhead. The SVG's first message line (data-from="U" data-to="App") has marker-end="url(#...-arrowhead)", confirming an arrowhead should render.

findings.summary: The EventEmitter→Observer association edge has no connecting line at all, unlike the three realization edges in the same diagram.
findings.evidence: asciiText shows EventEmitter's closing box border '└────────────────────────────┘' followed by three blank lines with no '│' or '┊', before the Observer box begins — while the Subject/EventEmitter, Observer/Logger and Observer/Alerter realization edges all correctly render '┊' dashed lines with '△' hollow-triangle arrowheads. The SVG's edge id_EventEmitter_Observer_4 has a marker-end (classDiagram-dependencyEnd), confirming a connector should render.
